title: Deploy canonical invariant registry MCP discovery
body: Expose five public read-only Threshold MCP tools over the existing canonical IRL public invariant APIs: list_invariants, get_invariant, search_invariants, list_invariants_for_experiment, and get_invariant_lineage. Pagination is honestly bounded to the canonical route's 500-row published snapshot; search is labelled keyword-only; lineage is explicitly limited to recorded supersession plus the public consequence-bearing neighbourhood. Root manifest and public capability discovery now report the registry as live. No new registry or direct database path was created.
